title: Divide an Array Into Subarrays With Minimum Cost II
description:
You are given a 0-indexed array of integers nums of length n , and two positive integers k and dist . 
 
 The cost of an array is the value of its first element. For example, the cost of [1,2,3] is 1 while the cost of [3,4,1] is 3 . 
 
 You need to divide nums into k disjoint contiguous subarrays , such that the difference between the starting index of the second subarray and the starting index of the kth subarray should be less than or equal to dist . In other words, if you divide nums into the subarrays nums[0..(i 1 - 1)], nums[i 1 ..(i 2 - 1)], ..., nums[i k-1 ..(n - 1)] , then i k-1 - i 1 <= dist . 
 
 Return the minimum possible sum of the cost of these subarrays . 

 Example 1: 
 
```
Input:
 nums = [1,3,2,6,4,2], k = 3, dist = 3

Output:
 5

Explanation:
 The best possible way to divide nums into 3 subarrays is: [1,3], [2,6,4], and [2]. This choice is valid because i
k-1

1
 is 5 - 2 = 3 which is equal to dist. The total cost is nums[0] + nums[2] + nums[5] which is 1 + 2 + 2 = 5.
It can be shown that there is no possible way to divide nums into 3 subarrays at a cost lower than 5.
```

code: class Solution {public:long long minimumCost(vector<int>& nums,int k,int dist){int n=nums.size(),need=k-2;multiset<int>lo,hi;long long sum=0;auto balance=[&](){while((int)lo.size()>need){auto it=prev(lo.end());sum-=*it;hi.insert(*it);lo.erase(it);}while((int)lo.size()<need&&!hi.empty()){auto it=hi.begin();sum+=*it;lo.insert(*it);hi.erase(it);}while(!lo.empty()&&!hi.empty()&&*prev(lo.end())>*hi.begin()){int a=*prev(lo.end()),b=*hi.begin();lo.erase(prev(lo.end()));hi.erase(hi.begin());lo.insert(b);hi.insert(a);sum+=b-a;}};auto insert=[&](int x){if(!lo.empty()&&x<*prev(lo.end()))lo.insert(x),sum+=x;else hi.insert(x);balance();};auto erase=[&](int x){auto it=lo.find(x);if(it!=lo.end())sum-=x,lo.erase(it);else{it=hi.find(x);if(it!=hi.end())hi.erase(it);}balance();};for(int j=2;j<n&&j<=1+dist;++j)insert(nums[j]);long long ans=LLONG_MAX;for(int i=1;i+need<n;++i){if((int)lo.size()==need)ans=min(ans,1LL*nums[0]+nums[i]+sum);if(i+1<n)erase(nums[i+1]);if(i+dist+1<n)insert(nums[i+dist+1]);}return ans;}};
